title_zh: 根据心愿单与价格选定植物礼物

scenario.label_zh: 根据心愿单与价格选定植物礼物
scenario.goal_zh: 比较植物标签和价格，选定收礼人心愿单上的预算内植物

context_zh: 顾客在植物商店为朋友挑选礼物。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: This exotic orchid is beautiful. The label says it comes from South America.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: It is lovely, but have you seen the price? It costs a fortune.

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: Yes, it is well beyond my budget. I was fortunate to find Mina's wish list before I came; she also wants this little cactus.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: That one is fifteen pounds, and it has the exact name she wrote down.

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: Then I will take the cactus. I would rather give her something she asked for.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Good choice. I will leave the plant label attached and wrap the pot.

targets.sense_zh: 来自异国而显得新奇的
